g.text: Sheet 4 of 4: door schedule, v0.7, 2026-10-06. All doors at one scale, dimensions in metres.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a
font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: The grey figure is 1.80 m tall and about 0.5 m across the shoulders, a little taller than the average adult man,

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: so most people have more room than shown. Rule used: at least 0.8 m clear width (0.9-1.0 m on every main

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: route, enough for a wheelchair or a crate trolley) and at least 2.0 m clear height across that width.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: Round doors: the circle's centre sits above the floor, so the floor cuts it and the opening stays wide at the feet

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: (1.14-1.19 m). The dashed green box shows the 0.9 x 2.0 m clear opening that fits inside each round door.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: The only exception is the emergency route E1: 1.8 m high, then a ladder up a 0.9 x 0.8 m shaft to a 0.8 x 0.8 m hatch.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: Stair to floor 2: 1.2 m wide, 20 risers of 195 mm, goings of 245 mm, open above for full headroom.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #35302a

g.text: Protective doors D4 and D5 must be certified units; check their sizes against DBN V.2.2-5:2023. Permits may be required.

path.style: fill: #35302a; stroke: #35302a; stroke-width: 0.6; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter
